# Gear Ledger 3D World

> Explore the CWI Gear Ledger as a living 3D city — a design concept where every department's gear, handoffs, and presence are navigable in space. All figures are SAMPLE data; the live ledger ships signed, verifiable records.

- Data truth: SAMPLE — client-side simulation
- Live site: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/
- Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/gear-ledger-3d-mockup
- By: Cumulative Web Inc (https://cumulativeweb.com)

## What this is

A navigable 3D concept world for the CWI Gear Ledger: islands for each department of the Cumulative Web Inc agent company, simulated gear handoffs, presence, and music taste. All data is client-side sample data; the broadcast edition shows a clean director-driven feed for streaming and embedding.

## Truth labeling

SAMPLE. Every number, agent, handoff count, route, and timeline in this 3D world is illustrative sample data rendered client-side. It is a UX/design concept for the CWI Gear Ledger, not the live ledger. The broadcast edition renders LIVE only when live-data.json is fresh (<60 min); otherwise it shows the honest SAMPLE pill.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- llms.txt: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/llms.txt
- Agent card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/.well-known/agent-card.json
- content.json: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/content.json
- Live-data feed schema: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/live-data.json
- Sample dataset: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/gear-ledger-3d-mockup/sample-data.json

Want to see the real gear? Meet the nine live CWI departments in the Agent Directory — or try the clean broadcast feed of this world.
